gloss: to wear well; to dress stylishly

definitions.gloss: to wear well; to dress stylishly; to carry off an outfit
definitions.explanation: To wear clothes in a way that looks natural and stylish. Implies skill or confidence in coordinating outfits and making them look good on oneself.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はスーツを{上手|じょうず}に{着|き}こなす。
{派手|はで}な{色|いろ}の{服|ふく}を{着|き}こなすのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to pull off clothes in flashy colors.

examples.japanese: {和服|わふく}を{自然|しぜん}に{着|き}こなせるようになりたい。
examples.english: I want to be able to wear traditional Japanese clothing naturally.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Godan verb (す ending, conjugates as s-row: {着|き}こなさない, {着|き}こなします). Transitive — takes a clothing item marked with を.

USAGE:
{着|き}こなす emphasizes skill and style in wearing clothes, not just the act of putting them on. It is commonly used in fashion contexts to praise someone's ability to make any outfit look good.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーツを{着|き}こなす (to wear a suit well)
- {和服|わふく}を{着|き}こなす (to wear kimono stylishly)
- {上手|じょうず}に{着|き}こなす (to dress well)
- おしゃれに{着|き}こなす (to wear fashionably)
